To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we present a novel approach to identify isoform-level expression levels from single-cell RNA-Seq data and 2) we show that our approach can identify isoform-level differences in single cells, and that these differences correlate with cell types.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and application of statistical methods for single-cell transcriptome data.
a novel method for the detection of differential expression of genes in single-cell RNA sequencing experiments.
the development of methods for the analysis of single-cell RNA- sequencing data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the single-cell RNA-Seq technique has the capability of detecting the expression of a gene from a single cell, and it is the most powerful technique to detect and quantify the expression of all the isoforms of a multi-exon gene in a single cell, which is the main advantage of the single-cell RNA-seq technique over other techniques.
the single cell transcriptomics data is not a true representation of the cell, rather it represents a snapshot in time of the transcriptome of the cell.
the single cell RNA-seq data are a valuable tool for the analysis of cell type heterogeneity, cell type identification, and cell state transitions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a novel method for isoform level expression analysis from scRNA-Seq data.
single-cell RNA-Seq data is not as clean as we would like it to be.
we developed and applied a novel statistical method to identify isoform-level gene expression in single-cell RNA-seq data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data can be analyzed using standard RNA-seq tools.

the isoform-level gene expression data is more informative than the gene-level gene expression data for cell type identification and cell type annotation, and the isoform-level data can also provide more information for cell type classification.
the use of isoform-level gene expression data can improve single-cell gene expression analyses in a variety of ways.
